card.name: Dosing interval words like every
card.fires_on: The word "every" (or the space or number just before it) in dosing schedules, mainly when the interval is long, such as every 48 hours, every other day or every 4 weeks.

modes.label: Every in long intervals
modes.description: The word every introducing a spaced-out interval, often in kidney-adjusted dosing.
modes.example: 0 mg every 48 hours. ( 2.4 ) CrCl 10–29 mL/min: 300 mg<< every>> 72 to 96 hours

modes.label: Inside the interval phrase
modes.description: The space or digit within an every-N-hours phrase, or the unit before every.
modes.example: 200 mg of trimethoprim every<< >>24 hours, each for 1

modes.label: Less frequent monitoring
modes.description: Words describing tests done less often after an initial period.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about delay and slowness and away from immediate or short.
card.plain: It lights up on the "every" in dosing schedules where doses or checks are spaced far apart.
